title: What If Every Vulture Vanished?

scenes.text: What if every vulture vanished? India already ran that experiment, and people paid for it.
In the mid-1990s a cheap cattle painkiller poisoned the vultures that ate the carcasses. Tens of millions fell to near extinction.
Without them, dead cattle rotted in the open. Water tests showed more germs where vultures used to be common.
Wild dogs moved in to feed, and rabies vaccine sales rose sharply.
Researchers estimate about one hundred thousand extra human deaths a year, roughly half a million from 2000 to 2005.
The drug was banned for cattle in 2006. The birds are the cleanup crew nobody thanked.

description:
What if every vulture vanished?
India lost nearly all its vultures to a cattle painkiller, and a University of Chicago study links it to roughly 500,000 extra human deaths between 2000 and 2005.
What should we run through next?
